title: Slime Hunt
brief: A knight whose sword swings on its own is steered by joystick through a meadow while slimes chase in; kill 12 to win, lose all 3 lives and you fall.

title: Grid Tag
brief: Step around a walled grid with a dpad collecting six flags while a hunter chases you and a sneaky tagger follows a decoy before retargeting you; three tags and you lose.

title: Shepherd Rush
brief: A sheepdog on a joystick leads six trailing sheep into the pen while wolves hunt the dog and the stragglers; pen five sheep to win, lose three sheep or three lives and you lose.

title: Coin Pit
brief: Drag a miner around a walled pit to grab eight coins while patrolling beetles cost lives.

title: Spark Dodge
brief: Drag a drone around a landscape arena while three turrets fire sparks across it; survive 40 seconds with a life left to win.

title: Wasp Nest
brief: A joystick bear collects honey pots in a clearing while a nest releases wasps that fly off in random directions; ten pots win, three stings lose.

title: Blast Zone
brief: Drag a courier to six crates while bombs flash and then explode in a cross at random spots; blasts cost lives.

title: Beacon Run
brief: Run a scout by joystick to light four beacons while a ghost chases you; each lit beacon sends the ghost after a wisp for a few seconds, and three catches lose.

title: Crypt Step
brief: Tap a dpad to step a thief through a crypt grid, taking five gems; every gem wakes another chasing bat and a mummy patrols the middle.

title: Puck Arena
brief: Drag a striker in air hockey against a robot that chases the puck; five goals in the top goal win, three goals conceded lose.

title: Knight Arena
brief: Two joystick arenas: sweep a trailing blade through ten goblins from two camps, then fight an ogre that is lured into a banner and stunned; the ogre takes eight hits.
